text:
Avery: quick thought dump — want to expose a tiny, best-effort quota hint from platform -> clients to improve SDK backoff UX and make console per-route sliders more accurate. Two delivery options I'm exploring:
1) best-effort response header `X-RW-QH` (compact JSON or base64)
2) websocket/pubsub stream for subscribed SDKs (realtime, opt-in)
header is easy to read in existing request/response flow, ws gives low-latency updates for interactive consoles. opt-in per-tenant behind a featureflag.

Noah: curious on telemetry footprint. if we expose, we should emit a canonical metric `quota.hint.exposed.v1` with tags {bucket, tenant, source} so console and alerts use same signal. start sampled at 0.5% then raise.

Zoe: watch out for CDNs and API gateways that strip custom headers. also CORS for browser clients. header must be tiny (<200 bytes) or it will get trimmed. prefer compact keys like `{b: \"chat\", r:120, R:1685000000, s:\"shared\"}` and base64-encode it.

Ravi: SDK surface ideas:
- python: sync callback `on_quota_hint` and non-blocking `get_last_quota_hint()`
- ts: EventEmitter `client.on('quota_hint', cb)` + optional Realtime subscription `client.realtime.subscribe('quota')`
- go: channel `QuotaHint() <-chan QuotaHint` and polling accessor
Keep default off; enable via config `quotaHints: false` to avoid noise. bump minor version for SDKs.

Avery: example header (compact json):
```
X-RW-QH: eyJiIjoiY2hhdCIsInIiOjEyMCwiUiI6MTY4NTAwMDAwMCwicCI6InNoZWxmIn0=
# decodes -> {"b":"chat","r":120,"R":1685000000,"p":"shelf"}
```
fields: b=bucket, r=remaining, R=reset_unix, p=quota_pool (shared|dedicated|reserved).

Noah: add `operation` tag too (prompt|embed|search) so alerts can distinguish noisy workloads. telemetry event should carry the same sample id as header when present so we can join.

Zoe: console UX: add a "SDK Hints" toggle per-org for A/B tests. if header present, show a per-route small gauge and optional toast when remaining < threshold. fall back to server-side rate metrics when missing.

Ravi: implementation concerns: websockets need auth + scale. maybe use existing livesync channel used by console. also need to define ACLs so tenant code can't subscribe to other tenants' hints.

Avery: rollout plan proposal:
- internal canary (10 internal tenants) with header-only, sampling 0.1%
- expand to 50 external partners, enable ws for a subset
- enable per-org console toggle and collect UX metrics (toasts, slowdown actions)
- full rollout when error/noise delta acceptable
Also include a migration step: server keeps mapping of old bucket ids -> friendly names for console.

Noah: please include retention limits and a TTL tag on telemetry; we must avoid keeping per-request hint events longer than 7 days unless sampled higher.

Zoe: pinging eng-infra for header-preservation checks across CDNs/caching layers (CloudFront, Fastly). also browser clients need CORS exposure of header.

Ravi: SDK changes checklist: docs, opt-in config, sample app showing realtime gauge, tests for header parsing robustness, graceful fallback when header malformed.

Avery: thanks — I'll draft a short RFC with header encoding, schema v1, telemetry metric + tags, SDK API sketches for py/ts/go, rollout canary matrix, and infra checklist. will tag owners.

infra-bot: infra lint: scheduled header-preserve-check job for cdn-compat at 6290012600.
